root_cause.text: The nfsd4_add_rdaccess_to_wrdeleg() function mishandles reference counting by overwriting an existing fi_fds[O_RDONLY] without releasing its reference, and by storing the same nfsd_file pointer in both fi_fds and fi_rdeleg_file without taking an additional reference, causing a leak in put_deleg_file() when the access count does not drop to zero.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a check `if (!fp->fi_fds[O_RDONLY])` before assigning, uses `nfsd_file_get()` for the delegation file, and adds `nfsd_file_put(rnf)` in `put_deleg_file()`. The commit description explicitly states the overwrite and single-reference issues.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix a reference leak by adding missing nfsd_file_put for rnf in put_deleg_file.
intent_record.what: Added a call to nfsd_file_put(rnf) inside the if (rnf) block and enclosed both statements in braces.
intent_record.how: Previously, when rnf was non-null, only nfs4_file_put_access was called. Now nfsd_file_put(rnf) is also called, ensuring the file reference is properly released.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix reference counting and avoid overwriting existing O_RDONLY file in nfsd delegation code.
intent_record.what: Changed assignment of fp->fi_fds[O_RDONLY] to only assign if currently NULL, set fp->fi_rdeleg_file using nfsd_file_get on the existing file, and put the passed nf if not used.
intent_record.how: Prevents overwriting an existing O_RDONLY file descriptor and properly manages reference counts: takes a reference when setting rdeleg_file and drops the unused new file reference, fixing potential use-after-free and reference leaks.
